title: Determination of total glutathione levels in Plasmodium falciparum infected RBCs
author: Unknown
license_note: Confirmed via CrossRef DOI metadata: dx.doi.org/10.17504/protocols.io.i35cgq6

steps.title: Harvest and lyse PfRBCs
steps.instruction: Harvest 5.4 × 10⁸ Plasmodium falciparum‑infected RBCs (5 % parasitemia) from culture, wash once with phosphate‑buffered saline, disrupt the packed cells by three freeze‑thaw cycles, add 100 µL of 5 % (w/v) sulfosalicylic acid (SSA, Wako catalogue 210‑01303), vortex, centrifuge 5 min at 8,000 g at 4 °C, and transfer the supernatant to 500 µL chilled ultrapure water to obtain a final volume of 600 µL.

steps.title: Select glutathione quantification kit
steps.instruction: Use either the total Glutathione Quantification kit (catalogue T419) or the GSSG/GSH Quantification kit (catalogue G257) from Dojindo Molecular Technologies, Inc., Rockville, MD, USA, according to the assay requirements.

steps.title: Perform glutathione assay using GSSG/GSH kit
steps.instruction: Prepare standards and run the assay as follows:

substeps.instruction: Prepare GSH standard solutions in 0.5 % SSA at concentrations 50, 25.0, 12.5, 6.25, 3.13, 1.57 and 0 µM.
Prepare GSSG standard solutions in 0.5 % SSA at concentrations 25.0, 12.5, 6.25, 3.13, 1.57, 0.78 and 0 µM.
Add 4 µL masking solution to each 200 µL GSSG standard and to each 200 µL sample (from step 1), mix well in micro‑tubes.
Aliquot 40 µL of each GSH standard, GSSG standard, and sample into separate wells of a 96‑well microtiter plate.
Add 60 µL Buffer solution to every well and incubate the plate at 37 °C for 1 hour.
Add 60 µL Substrate working solution to each well.
Add 60 µL Enzyme/Coenzyme working solution to each well and mix thoroughly.
Incubate the plate again at 37 °C for 10 minutes.
Measure absorbance at 405 nm (OD 405) with a microplate reader and calculate total GSH and GSSG concentrations by comparison to the respective standard curves.
